headline: Chowan overtake Young Harris as the conference's top scorers
dek: Chowan have scored nineteen goals, more than any other programme, and eleven different players have shared them. The goals have not bought a clean record: Chowan have lost two matches and drawn two, and Young Harris, still unbeaten, remain above them in the table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Chowan's nineteen goals have come from eleven different scorers and still sit beside two defeats and two draws; goals have not been the shortage.

wire.line: King have lost every match they have played; Lees-McRae have yet to lose one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fifteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist on Aug 13 and the latest Mount Olive's visit to Virginia State on Sep 4.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: King have lost all six of their matches, scoring three goals and conceding seventeen; only two players have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Enzo Joly, a freshman, has six of Emmanuel's fourteen goals, from eighteen shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ferrum have won three matches and drawn two and are yet to lose; they have conceded four goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jackson Bennett has been beaten eight times for Belmont Abbey and has kept three clean sheets.

last_match.line: Chowan have not lost since Francis Marion beat them at home; Barton have yet to win a conference match.

next_match.line: Young Harris have won every conference match they have played; Converse have not won since their visit to King.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
